results.text: Indi Hartwell defeated Xia Brookside and retained the Knockouts World Championship
Cedric Alexander defeated Rich Swann, KC Navarro and Fabian Aichner
Jason Hotch defeated Mustafa Ali and retained the TNA International Championship
results.match_type: Two Out of Three Falls Championship Match

Kiera Hogan and Tasha Steelz attacked Allie; Shotzi Blackheart intervened on Allie's behalf
